## Current appointment

**Ezra Systems Postdoctoral Associate**<br>
Systems Engineering Program<br>
Cornell University, Ithaca, New York

I work with [Professor Fengqi You](https://www.peese.org/professor/) on physical intelligence for materials processing. The current system is initiated chemical vapor deposition coupled with liquid crystals.
